rows.thrust_source: system.yaml devices Y_MOTOR / Y1_MOTOR desc + params PULLEY_TEETH

rows.mechanism: lid lift: plate lids and the sealing lid by the gripper (lid < 0.05 kg + 5 N suction, ASSUMED)
rows.thrust_source: system.yaml z_drive.recomputed.worst_thrust_N_at (mu 0.20, usable torque, at speed) '0.9'

rows.mechanism: gripper grip: hold the heaviest plate (clamp needed at pad friction 0.5, head report) at the jaw motor's usable torque

rows.note: the settable range GRIP_FORCE_N 5-20 N is a setting, not the need; at the 20 N top setting the drive has 1.18

rows.mechanism: gripper grip at the firmware's jaw current (printer.cfg [tmc5160 manual_stepper gripper] run_current 0.35 A)
rows.note: MISSING: the jaw motor's RATED current (maker's sheet of the 28HS32-class motor; the usable 0.04 N m is at its rating) to scale the torque to 0.35 A, OR the rig measurement of the grip force at 0.35 A (gripped-switch force on the S-cell)

rows.mechanism: TC-1 lid slide (belt, chain drag, rail friction, acceleration)
rows.drive: TC-1 Y motor (NEMA17 pancake, GT2 20T), stall torque class

rows.mechanism: TC-1 lid clamp (presser compresses 2 die springs to its hard stop + return springs)
rows.drive: TC-1 clamp NEMA17 x 34 with integrated Tr8x2 (0.30 N m class, eff 0.35) on a DM542 set to 1.0 A peak
rows.note: FAILS the 1.5 rule (TC-1 owner, rev H; not changed in this round): the 0.30 N m is the motor class at its rating, and the DM542 is set to 1.0 A peak, whose torque is not known (maker's rated current MISSING), so the true margin is lower still.  Closing it: a NEMA17 x 48 integrated-screw class (about 0.45 N m: margin about 1.9) if the lid carriage height allows, or springs at the low end of the 220-300 N seal range; then measure on the TC-1 rig (T-TC-05)

rows.mechanism: plunger push, largest tool (SYR 80 N incl. return spring; S1000 60 N) at <= 5 mm/s
rows.drive: LGA35 pusher at 0.7 A (sourcing curve, INFERENCE)

travel.what: pusher stroke incl. the 3 mm contact window

rows.note: the lower of the sourcing file's 0.7 A curve reading (128 N at 5 mm/s) and system.yaml's own model (128.3 N at 0.7 A, 1 mm-lead class; its fields not yet updated to the 0.61 mm lead); at 8 mm/s the curve gives 115 N: margin 1.44, so force strokes stay <= 5 mm/s

rows.mechanism: plunger contact (pusher pad on the slider, contact switch about 2 N, ASSUMED)

rows.note: current limit check: homing 0.50 A <= maker limit 0.57 A: PASS

rows.mechanism: syringe tool return spring (plunger out, end of a refill) vs seal friction + check valve (V22)
rows.drive: return spring 0.493 N/mm, 7.4 N out (passive; at the -10 % rate tolerance 6.7 N: margin 1.66)

travel.what: solid length <= length at full stroke (4 mm left)
